messages.subject: For Paul Hudson | Global healthcare, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Sanofi Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Paul Hudson, Chief Executive Officer.

Sanofi's global healthcare platform operates across governments, regulators, health systems, communities and major investment priorities. That stakeholder environment closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across a complex regulated emerging-market operation.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, global stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Sanofi's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Sanofi.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
